site.name: Euravia
site.description: Euravia sources, packs and supplies premium fresh and IQF frozen fruit and vegetables from Morocco and the Mediterranean to buyers across Europe. Offices in Utrecht and Casablanca.

fresh.name: Fresh produce
fresh.short: Vegetables and fruit, packed on harvest day
fresh.blurb: Sun-ripened Moroccan vegetables and fruit, harvested at the right moment and packed to reach your distribution centre in peak condition.

vegetables.name: Fresh vegetables
vegetables.blurb: Tomatoes, peppers, eggplants, zucchini and green beans from Morocco's greenhouse regions, with consistent sizing, uniform colour and a long shelf life.

fruits.name: Fresh fruit
fruits.blurb: Avocados, citrus, berries and melons grown between the Atlas and the Atlantic, with the sweetness, aroma and firmness European shoppers expect.

home.heroTitle: Fresh & frozen produce, from Moroccan fields to European shelves
home.heroText: Premium vegetables, fruit and IQF berries, sourced at origin and delivered through a controlled cold chain.
home.title: Your trusted gateway to the finest fresh and frozen produce of the Mediterranean
home.lead: We source, pack and supply premium fruit and vegetables directly from the most fertile regions of Morocco, Spain and the wider Mediterranean.
paragraphs: Founded with a passion for agricultural excellence and reliable logistics, Euravia bridges the gap between sun-drenched coastal farms and global markets.

Whether you need fresh produce picked at the peak of ripeness or individually quick frozen (IQF) fruit that keeps its nutritional value and flavour, our international clients receive the highest standard, exactly when they need it.
home.pillarsTitle: Five reasons buyers source with Euravia

pillars.title: Sun-ripened origin
pillars.text: Fertile regions such as Souss-Massa and the Atlantic coast, with sunshine almost all year round.

pillars.title: Early-season supply
pillars.text: Morocco harvests when European production is low, so your shelves stay full.

pillars.title: Cold chain & IQF
pillars.text: Temperature-controlled from farm to delivery, and berries frozen right after harvest.

pillars.title: Traceability & standards
pillars.text: Full traceability and international quality standards, including GlobalG.A.P. certification.

pillars.title: Two offices, one chain
pillars.text: Casablanca at the source, Utrecht next to our European customers.

iqfPoints.title: Year-round
iqfPoints.text: A seasonal crop becomes a stable supply for your production planning.

points.title: Climate
points.text: Atlas-sheltered valleys, Atlantic breezes and sunshine almost all year.

points.title: Timing
points.text: Harvests start early in the season, when European fields are still empty.

points.title: Proximity
points.text: A short crossing to Europe means fresher produce and longer shelf life on arrival.

about.title: Welcome to Euravia
about.lead: Your trusted gateway to the finest fresh and frozen fruit from the heart of the Mediterranean.
mission: Euravia was founded with a passion for agricultural excellence and reliable logistics. We specialise in sourcing, packing and supplying premium produce directly from the most fertile regions of Morocco, Spain and the wider Mediterranean basin.
By bridging the gap between sun-drenched coastal farms and global markets, we make sure our international clients receive the highest standard of fruit and vegetables, exactly when they need them.

morocco.title: Morocco
morocco.text: Optimal growing conditions and proximity to Europe. We source exceptional citrus, field-fresh berries, vegetables and stone fruit, packed on harvest day.

mediterranean.title: Spain & the Mediterranean
mediterranean.text: Advanced agricultural infrastructure for stable, year-round supplies of premium watermelons, grapes, avocados and seasonal produce.

about.promiseTitle: Fresh or frozen, the same commitment
about.promiseText: Whether you need fresh produce picked at the peak of ripeness or individually quick frozen (IQF) fruit that preserves its nutritional value and flavour, Euravia is committed to quality, rigorous food-safety standards and seamless logistics.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.lead: How Euravia handles the personal data you send us through this website.

sections.p: Euravia, with offices at Mississippidreef 95, 3565 CE Utrecht, the Netherlands, and in Casablanca, Morocco, is responsible for the processing of personal data described here. Contact: info@euraviafoods.com.
Only what you type into the contact and quote forms: name, company, e-mail address, phone number, country, the products you selected and your message.

To answer your request and, if you become a customer, to prepare and follow up quotes and orders. The legal basis is your request (pre-contractual steps) and our legitimate interest in answering business enquiries.
Enquiries that do not lead to business are deleted after 24 months. Customer records are kept as long as required by tax and commercial law.
We do not sell your data. Form messages are delivered through our e-mail provider. Logistics partners only receive what is needed to deliver an order.
This website sets no tracking cookies. Your quote selection and language choice are stored in your own browser (local storage) and never sent to us until you submit a form.

You may ask to access, correct or delete your data, or object to its use, by writing to info@euraviafoods.com. You may also complain to the Dutch Data Protection Authority (Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens).
